title: May dev@web-summit.angelo change shared site code through a board issue it has picked?
detail: Angelo's agents' policy (part two of his brief) and dev@web-summit.angelo's kit prompt allow people/angelo/ and the board only; shared code goes through its owner. Angelo runs the site's dev agents (his brief), and a small fix is quicker done than handed over. WS-140 (Give feedback opens the pane) is done by dev@web-summit.angelo at Angelo's one-off go, with dev@web-summit.dinis told. No owner per area of the site's code is written down.
recommend: Yes, through a picked board issue with the owner told in the commit; part two of Angelo's brief and his dev agent's prompt updated to say so
options: Yes, through a picked board issue, the owner told in the commit
Yes, with the owner's go per change
No: shared code goes to its owner
